# Atomic Habits Lab

> A calm, minimalist sandbox for designing habits using the cue/craving/response/reward loop and the Four Laws of Behavior Change.

Atomic Habits Lab helps students, professionals, creators, and anyone else design tiny, repeatable habits and stress-test them against the Four Laws (make it obvious, attractive, easy, satisfying). All data is stored locally in the browser — no account required.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, presets, and how the lab works.
- [Lab](/lab): Three-panel sandbox to build a habit loop, apply the Four Laws, and track streaks.
- [Learn](/learn): Plain-language explanations of the habit loop, the Four Laws, and identity-based habits.
- [Habit Stacking guide](/learn/habit-stacking): How to use the "After [Current Habit], I will [New Habit]" formula.
